Is it possible for source to kBroker and destination to be kNonBroker, yet the remote process is untrusted?

Also do we need to consider elevation here?

Yes: browser->renderer transports are {kBroker, kNonBroker} and untrusted, since renderers are launched with MOJO_SEND_INVITATION_FLAG_UNTRUSTED_PROCESS. Allowing it there is intentional, because mojo::DirectReceiver in renderers relies on is_same_remote_process to introduce an in-process node to the broker.

It's safe because the broker won't adopt kRecipient handles from an untrusted non-broker (`CanAcceptReceiverOwnedHandles()` requires peer trust). So the only processes that can end up here are the broker's own handle to that peer (is_same_remote_process), or a handle the peer itself held, duplicated out of the peer as kSender. Neither gives the peer anything beyond what it already has.
